review.tagline: Azure azd template for a Foundry agent chat app with file search
review.summary: Deploys a web chat app on Azure Container Apps backed by a Microsoft Foundry Agent Service agent. The agent answers from uploaded files using file search or optional Azure AI Search and returns citations. Tracing goes to Application Insights, and the repo includes Pytest-based agent evaluation and red-teaming scans.
review.audience: Azure developers who want a deployable Foundry agent reference app
strengths: Single `azd up` provisions Foundry project, model, Container App, storage and monitoring
Tracing via Application Insights and Azure Monitor included
Pytest agent evaluation and AI Red Teaming scans included
Managed Identity used for deployment and local development
weaknesses: Requires an Azure subscription and Foundry model quota; no non-Azure path
README warns the code is a showcase, not production-ready without extra security
Costs are usage-based and the README gives no estimate
Deployment takes 7–15 minutes with `azd up`; teardown up to 20
needs: Bicep, gpt-5-mini (default), other Azure AI models configurable
Needs Microsoft Foundry, Foundry Agent Service, Azure Container Apps, Azure Container Registry, Azure Storage, Azure AI Search (optional), Application Insights (optional), Log Analytics (optional)
